text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in stages let me realize gains while keeping some exposure to further upside; I should base future sales on my target allocation and outlook, not gains alone.","A winning stock can still fall sharply, so I should manage concentration and risk rather than assume past gains will continue.","I should judge decisions by the portfolio’s overall progress and a consistent plan, not by the satisfaction of locking in gains or the pain of selling at a loss."]}
